ownerWords: The owner approved the Phase 2 plan with its defaults and told the agents to start the wave. On the next day the owner accepted the defaults for the eight open questions, allowed the fifteen named Phase 1 test checks to be updated and no more, and chose the cash-book route that writes a zero-amount marker row through the bridge, so the Expense page is not edited. Phase 2 covers: estimates from the masters, the approval form, advances, the bill (tax invoice with the GST split), receipts, cancel, credit note and refund, job void, counter-sale money, the day summary, two control lists and the cash-book route through the bridge. Valuation stays FIFO. Phases 3 to 5 are not built. The owner named no capability, no identity re-binding and no hash.
